title: Space Chatter Radio Beep
desc: Whether to include a radio beep at the start and end of a spoken space chatter message

title: Space Chatter Radio white noise level
desc: The level of white noise heard when radio effect is applied (0-20)

title: Space Chatter Radio pop and click frequency
desc: The amount of pops and clicks heard when radio effect is applied (0-50)

title: Space Chatter Radio distortion level
desc: The amount of voice distortion when radio effect is applied (0-50)

title: Space Chatter Radio High Pass Filter
desc: Set this in the range 1200-2500. A higher value will sound more tinny and distant

title: Space Chatter - Random Voice Effects (currently applies only to Edge voices)
Apply random effect to voices
desc: If ON, will apply a random effect (currently radio static or synthetic voice)

title: Apply random pitch to voices
desc: If ON, will apply a random pitch to character voices

title: Random Pitch - Low Pitch value
desc: When generating random pitched voices, this is the lowest adjustment, in -Hz, that will be considered (set this between -40 and 0)

title: Random Pitch - High Pitch
desc: When generating random pitched voices, this is the highest adjustment, in +Hz, that will be considered (set this between 0 and 40)

title: Space Chatter - Voice Placement Settings (requires Cloud voice provider(s))
Left Speaker volume
desc: Volume percentage in left ear (applies a percentage to Space Chatter volume * individual message-type volume.). Keep at least one of the speakers in the 80-100 range.

title: Right Speaker volume
desc: Volume percentage in left ear (applies a percentage to Space Chatter volume * individual message-type volume.) Keep at least one of the speakers in the 80-100 range.

title: Randomly assign left-right speaker levels
desc: If ON, will randomly switch left and right percentages .. example if you have Left=100, Right=0 then voices will normally sound in left ear only. With this ON, will randomly pick left only vs right only for played conversations.

title: Alternate left-right speaker levels
desc: If ON, will alternately switch left and right percentages .. example if you have Left=100, Right=0 then voices will normally sound in left ear only. With this ON, will alternate conversations between left and right ear
